T: Help me, I'm poor. Have a cupcake.
D: A maid of honour's life unravels as she competes with a rich new friend over the bride.
P: Serve dessert when Annie bakes her one perfect cupcake.
S: Crisp, chewy almond meringue shells tinted pale pink, sandwiched with a tangy raspberry and white chocolate ganache, rested a day so they go soft in the middle. Sift 150g almond meal with 150g icing sugar and mix with 55g egg white to a paste. Boil 150g caster sugar and 40ml water to 118C and pour into 55g egg whites whisking to a stiff meringue, add pink colour. Fold into the paste until it flows like lava. Pipe 4cm rounds, rest 30 minutes and bake at 145C for 14 minutes. Melt 120g white chocolate with 60ml cream and 3 tbsp raspberry jam, cool and sandwich.

Cubes of squeaky haloumi dipped in a light lager batter and fried until crunchy and golden, with a cold herby ranch dip. Cut 400g haloumi into 2cm cubes and pat dry. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 egg and 200ml cold lager into a batter. Mix 150g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, chopped dill, chives, garlic powder and a squeeze of lemon for ranch. Heat 1L oil to 185C, dip the cheese in batter and fry in batches for 1 minute until golden. Drain and salt lightly.
Annie's bakery that didn't make it

Cinnamon scrolls: yeasted dough with butter, brown sugar and cinnamon rolled, cut, proved, baked at 190C for 20 minutes, iced. Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 250ml warm milk and 50g butter and prove an hour. Roll out, spread with 60g butter, 80g brown sugar and 1 tbsp cinnamon. Roll, cut 12 and prove 30 minutes. Bake at 190C for 20 minutes and ice with 100g cream cheese beaten with icing sugar.
M: Wedding lemon thyme chicken and gratin
the big wedding Helen plans to the last detail

Golden pan-roasted chicken breast in a white wine, lemon and thyme cream sauce, with a slow-baked potato gratin and buttered greens. Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes with 300ml cream, a crushed garlic clove and salt and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Brine 4 skin-on chicken breasts in salted water for 1 hour, pat dry and fry skin down in 30g butter for 5 minutes, then flip and roast at 200C for 12 minutes. Add 125ml white wine to the pan and reduce, then 150ml cream, lemon juice and thyme. Steam 300g green beans and broccolini with butter.
the trip to Vegas that never makes it past the plane
Rigatoni cooked 2 minutes short, finished in a sauce of tomato simmered 20 minutes with garlic and chilli, tossed with torn burrata and basil just before serving.
W: the one cupcake she makes alone late at night
Vanilla bean cupcakes baked at 170C for 18 minutes, piped with a tall swirl of pale pink Swiss meringue buttercream, finished with a little sugar flower made from fondant.
K: Chilled rosé with pink grapefruit juice and soda over lots of ice, sliced strawberries and a sprig of mint in big wine glasses. Fill 4 large wine glasses with ice and sliced strawberries. Add 120ml chilled rosé and 40ml pink grapefruit juice to each and top with 60ml soda water. Stir gently and finish with a sprig of mint. Keep the bottle on ice so every top-up stays cold.

m.how: Simmer 2 tins crushed tomatoes with 3 sliced garlic cloves and chilli flakes for 20 minutes. Cook 500g rigatoni 2 minutes short and finish it in the sauce. Tear 2 burrata over the top with basil just before serving.

w.note: the one cupcake she makes alone late at night
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar and vanilla bean seeds, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 170C for 18 minutes. Whisk 2 whites and 120g sugar over hot water, beat in 200g butter, tint pale pink and pipe tall. Add a fondant flower.
